intro.title: About University Square
intro.description: Piața Universității is one of the most historically significant squares in Bucharest, and an important symbol of the 1989 Romanian Revolution. The square is surrounded by important buildings including the University of Bucharest and the former National Library, making it an excellent place to experience Romanian history and culture.

visitGuide.title: Visit Tips
items: Recommended to visit in the evening for night lights
Square is open 24 hours, can visit anytime
Wear comfortable walking shoes, square is best explored on foot

alsoKnownAs.title: Highlights
items: Historical and cultural heart of Bucharest

hours.title: Opening Hours
hours.tipContent: Square is open 24 hours, but evening light effect is best. Many cafes and restaurants nearby for resting.
hours.note: Opening hours of surrounding buildings (University Library, etc.) may vary

tickets.title: Ticket Information
tickets.museumsDesc: Includes access to several nearby museums
tickets.cardPrice: Enjoy public transport and ticket discounts

transport.title: How to Get Here
transport.metroDesc: University Station (M1, M2 lines), 2 min walk
transport.airportDesc: Direct metro or taxi from Bucharest Airport, approx 20-30 mins.
transport.tipsDesc: Square is located in city center, convenient public transportation. Recommended to walk or take metro.

route.title: Recommended Route
route.overview: Recommended to visit in the evening, starting from University Square, visiting Revolution Monument, former National Library, National Theatre, Athenaeum Square in sequence. The whole walk is relaxing and easy. Standard visit takes 30 minutes to 1 hour.
steps: Arrive at University Square Metro Station, walk to the center of the square
Visit the Revolution Monument and sculpture group, learn about 1989 Revolution history
Stroll to the former National Library building, admire the building exterior
Head to nearby Bucharest National Theatre
Relax at nearby cafés, feel the relaxed atmosphere of Bucharest
If time permits, visit nearby museums or shopping malls
Return via the original route or continue exploring nearby attractions
supplements: Square is open 24 hours, but evening light effect is best
There are many cafés and restaurants nearby, can rest at any time
Pay attention to personal belongings, especially in crowded areas
Recommended to combine with nearby attractions (National Theatre, Athenaeum, etc.)
